name: scratch/app-test
description: Disposable scratch application, generated from app/. Local only; not published, no remote.
//repositories: Neither library is on Packagist yet, so all three resolve from GitHub. `dev-main` tracks the branch rather than a release, so an application install follows whatever the libraries' `main` currently is — reproducible only while `composer.lock` is committed, which it is. The local path repositories that used to sit here made a sibling checkout resolve offline, at the cost of not working from a clone at all.
//harness: This manifest REPLACES app/composer.json wholesale — dev/tools/app-test copies it over the clone rather than merging the two, so the skeleton has one manifest and the scratch app has this one. Nothing keeps them in step: when app/composer.json changes a shared dependency, change it here too, or the scratch app quietly tests an install nobody ships. src/App.php is replaced the same way, which is why it names DebugToolsModule itself rather than editing the skeleton's App — the skeleton's is a different class entirely, and retyping the wiring is what proves it is usable. The profiler is require-dev: it is a development tool, and shipping it in an install nobody develops with is a dependency nobody chose. The `seed` script works here because src/Console/SeedCommand.php sits where the skeleton's own bootstrap discovers commands — which is exactly what could not have happened in the skeleton, where the broken `@seed` script used to sit.
